items.title: EU proposes entry ban for Russians who fought in Ukraine
items.description: The EU's 21st sanctions package includes a provision to deny entry to anyone who has served in Russia's armed forces amid the invasion of Ukraine. It will also target the so-called shadow fleet, banks and cryptocurrency.

items.title: Rising cyberscam losses expose gaps in EU response
items.description: Europeans are losing billions to online scams, yet the EU has been slower than the US, the UK and China in targeting the Southeast Asian networks behind many of them.

items.title: NASA picks first European astronaut for Artemis mission
items.description: Italian astronaut Luca Parmitano will be the lead pilot for the Artemis III test flight. The NASA mission is expected to launch in 2027 to test technology for a future moon landing.
